judges.justification: All primary genomic claims (chromosome/plasmid length, combined size, GC%, total genes, RNA genes) reproduce exactly from the deposited CP012024.1/CP012025.1 records, with only trivial deltas in CDS/pseudogene counts attributable to RefSeq re-annotation. The paper's key biological interpretation — absence of pfl, pta, and ackA — is independently confirmed by both name-based search and BLASTP homology with a working positive control (LDH). Plasmid presence/size (the actual paper claim) reproduces exactly, and the Table 6 comparative genome stats and ANI-based placement are consistent. Coverage is near-complete; only Pfam/COG counts (C11/C12) were partially tested.

judges.justification: Primary falsifiable genome-announcement claims (chromosome/plasmid length, total genome size, GC%, total genes, and RNA gene counts) were independently re-measured from the deposited accessions and match the paper exactly or within rounding. The key biological interpretation (absence of pfl/pta/ackA and related acetate-pathway genes) is confirmed by both annotation text search and BLASTP with appropriate controls. Minor discrepancies are confined to annotation-detail fields (protein-coding and pseudogene counts), likely due to post-publication RefSeq re-annotation rather than a contradiction of the underlying assembly or the paper’s main claims.

judges.justification: All primary genomic claims (C1–C5, C7) reproduce exactly from the deposited NCBI sequences, and combined size (C3) and GC% (C4) match within rounding. The metabolic gene absence claims (C14) are confirmed by both homology-based BLASTP and annotation text searches, which is the paper's main biological interpretation. The small discrepancies in protein-coding count (Δ8, 0.22%) and pseudogene count (Δ8, ~6%) are consistent with routine RefSeq re-annotation rather than errors in the original paper. Plasmid presence and size (C13) are fully confirmed; the absence of a PlasmidFinder rep-family hit is congruent with the paper's own 'hypothetical protein'-only annotation and does not contradict any claim the paper actually makes.
